blocks.content: 3. Bucket Naming: Globally Unique

blocks.text: 9. Lifecycle Rules: Managing Real Storage Cost

blocks.content: A real S3 lifecycle rule automatically transitions or deletes real, aging objects, genuinely managing storage cost over an object's real, actual lifetime.
A real, common pattern moves older, real logs to cheaper storage after a set number of real days, then genuinely deletes them entirely after a longer, real period.

blocks.content: 10. Bucket Policies vs IAM Policies

A bucket policy is often preferred for real, cross-account access, an IAM policy for controlling one, specific, real identity's own permissions.
